comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item (Special Gift for Aide Fleet) is awarded to companies who trigger one of several new rare fleet events and are successful in completing it. The contents from JP wiki are:

Master's Tailoring Tools x10
Aide Training x1 (removed from Maris)
Silver Tarot x1
Pegasus Feather x1
Simple Sailor Equip. Repair Tools x1
Master's Repair Tools x10
Consumable Storage Expansion x1 (removed from Maris)
Ship Part/Material Storage Expansion x1 (removed from Maris)
Inventory Expansion Bag x1 (removed from Maris)
Celestial Globe Anchor (ship deco)
Sword & Shield (ship deco)
Acanthus (ship deco) -- different from the SoW rare sea drop deco

The above list is likely altered for Maris. Though if by some chance you get one of the removed items, do let us know. Cheers.

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body: So far i got MTTs, Aide Training(a bug, i know), MRT, Acanthus and Deep Sea Beech Plating.

comments.body: Amazingly, I know some who actually got the three different expansion items. But that was pre-maintenance; I don't know of any received since then.

comments.body: Does anyone figure out how to increase the odds to get the special rare aide fleet activity for this gift? It seems very rare enough, only got one since the SW CH1 update.
